title: Tinsmith trade school at Xavier after the WPA
summary: After the WPA broke up he trained as a tinsmith at Xavier, with Picou teaching the night class, but stayed in music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Yeah, so, uh, well, I played in that, uh, let's see, WPA band now. What else? Yeah, so after the WPA band broke up, well, to keep us, they gave, they sent us to what they, I don't know if they called it, they called it something else before, but it was a trade school. That's why I went to Xavier University. And I was learning how to be a tinsmith. You know? But Piku, huh? Huh? Piku used to be a tinsmith. Piku, that's right. Because Piku was a teacher over there.

Yeah, Piku was a teacher over there. And there were two teachers, Piku and, uh, uh, uh, this guy's name is Morellis. Well, Morellis was teaching me. Yeah. See, I didn't, Piku was teaching the night class. Yeah. And I was going to day class.

I didn't know where I did. Yeah, Piku was teaching over there, sure. And, uh, but I used to go over there and I finished the course and, uh, and Tinsmith, and those boys were sent to different shipyards and everything. I said, you have to have a defense job to keep out the army and all that.
